messages:
taylor: Noticed prod-euc2 warm-pool failing to complete final healthcheck after the config rollout at 01:00 UTC. Nodes reach PROVISIONED then get ejected.

infra-bot: ALERT 1769876543 - warmpool-join-fail x11 in prod-euc2: errors observed: kms:DecryptDenied, hsm-proxy 403, eni_attach_timeout.

sam: See logs from node-agent: `attestation: error=403 hsm-proxy grant=gr-euc2-rotated` and `sts:AssumeRole denied due to IpAddress condition mismatch`. Looks like the key rotation + new fw rule converged badly.

june: Quick options: (1) issue a scoped, one-hour KMS grant for the allocator role + ephemeral SG egress to audit-shipper; (2) rollback FW-REGION-HARD rule for the audit-shipper target only; (3) fallback warmups to prod-usw2 (expensive). I prefer (1).

liam: Cost note for fallback (3): routing 12 nodes cross-region estimated ~2.5TB/day => ~$380/day egress and increased tail latency. Not ideal for automatic fallback.

sec-bot: Security checklist for temporary grant: must be (a) scoped to arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-allocator, (b) TTL=1h enforced, (c) grant creation event pushed to s3://secure-audit/warmups/, (d) two-person approval recorded. Approve only if revoke automated.

sam: I'll prepare the terraform + grant script. Plan: target SG rule with lifecycle tag ttl=60m, create-grant with EncryptionContextSubset {"purpose":"hsm-attest"}, write grant metadata to S3, schedule lambda revoke in 60m.

june: Running minimal commands (sanitized):
```
# create ephemeral grant
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/infra-hsm --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-allocator --operations Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"purpose":"hsm-attest"}}' --name ephemeral-warmup > /tmp/grant.json
# terraform patch: allow egress from prod-euc2 NAT to audit-shipper cidr for 60m
terraform apply -target=aws_security_group_rule.euc2-audit-allow -var='env=prod-euc2'
```

infra-bot: UPDATE: grant created id=gr-euc2-ephemeral; terraform apply succeeded; nodes requeued. Progress: joined 6/11, retrying 5.

sam: Logged grant details to s3://secure-audit/warmups/2026-03-23/gr-euc2-ephemeral.json and recorded approvals via approvals-service. Lambda revoke job scheduled at 2026-03-23T02:05:00Z.

liam: Good. Follow-ups: (A) ensure allocator refreshes session tokens on key rotations (session refresh webhook), (B) add an e2e test simulating grant expiry mid-join, (C) audit FW-REGION-HARD to explicitly allow audit-shipper endpoints used in attestation. I'll open PRs for these.

sec-bot: Verified audit log presence and two approvals. Security holds until revoke completes successfully; monitoring window 2h after resolution.

infra-bot: FINAL: warm pool stabilized; final status 11/11 joined. INCIDENT INC-20260323-14 created; monitor window 2h; revoke scheduled.

taylor: Thanks everyone. Action items assigned: sam=grant script + revoke automation, liam=PRs for session refresh + tests, june=FW rule review. We'll run a short blameless postmortem if this reoccurs.
